guidelines: A pair is a claim and one citation into the pinned snapshot. supported=true only when the cited lines alone show every code fact the claim states.
Anchors are regular expressions over the cited span: present=true must match, present=false must not (absence anchors). The label must agree with its anchors; validation re-checks this on every run.

Calibration pairs are written by hand from the snapshot source, before any judge output was seen. Kinds: supported, supported_absence, wrong_claim (real path, false statement), invented_behaviour (real symbol, behaviour it does not have).
labels holds verdicts for pairs the recorded pipeline produced. Copy key, claim and citation from the support suite's 'pair/' cases; use supported=null when the text states no fact about the code.

calibration.claim: groundReport keeps a repository_evidence entry only when its path was examined, cited by an evaluation, or appears in repository memory.
groundReport also removes narratives and struggled questions that mention files the interview never touched.
buildReportInput passes each evaluation's discrepancy flag to the report model but not its discrepancy_detail.
buildReportInput passes discrepancy_detail to the report model so it can quote the contradiction.
buildReportInput gives the report model each evaluation's rating but not its numeric score.
classifyReportError makes a model refusal non-retriable but lets other invalid output be retried.
classifyReportError gives up immediately when the model provider rate-limits the request.
evaluateAnswer gives the model 9 seconds per attempt with one retry.
When the evaluation model fails, evaluateAnswer logs the error and returns an internal failure without any fallback score.
evaluateAnswer falls back to a keyword heuristic score when the model times out.
The evaluation system prompt forbids putting a score, rating or judgement of the candidate in focus.

anchors.pattern: focus is spoken guidance for the interviewer: never include a score, rating, or judgement

calibration.claim: normalizePlan resets every coverage area to not_started.
normalizePlan drops phases that are left with no known coverage area.
normalizePlan rejects plans with fewer than five coverage areas.
buildPlanningInput stops adding memory rows once the MAX_MEMORY_CHARS budget is spent.
buildPlanningInput sends every repository memory row to the planner without a size limit.

anchors.note: an unbounded input would not mention the budget

calibration.claim: priorGuidance passes only the interview number, status, coverage statuses and per-category ratings, strengths and gaps of earlier interviews.
